purpose: Custom scalpel mouse cursor for the operating-table palpation prototype
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: small custom mouse cursor for a medical visual-novel game UI. Use the attached scalpel only as a reference for the instrument silhouette and diagonal orientation. Create one clean metallic surgical scalpel cursor, with the sharp blade tip pointing to the bottom-left and the handle extending to the top-right. Polished 2D anime game UI asset, crisp readable silhouette, cool silver metal with restrained highlights. Single isolated scalpel centered diagonally, generous transparent padding; blade tip must remain clearly visible and be the intended click hotspot. Genuinely transparent background, no text, no watermark, no logo, no hands, no blood, no cast shadow, no surrounding objects; suitable for downscaling to 64x64 pixels.
notes: The game downsizes this source to a 72x72 custom cursor at runtime and places the cursor hotspot at the blade tip.
